title: InjectionAck
description:
Acknowledgement returned by the three injection-queue methods.

The wire shape is always `{"accepted":true}`; a `false` value is reserved for future use but currently cannot be emitted by the server.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::InjectionAck; let ack = InjectionAck::accepted(); let v = serde_json::to_value(&ack).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v["accepted"], true); let back: InjectionAck = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, ack); ```

accepted.description: `true` when the items were accepted into the queue.
